arxiv-2101-10236.title: Degenerated Liouvillians and Steady-State Reduced Density Matrices
arxiv-2101-10236.creator: Juzar Thingna, Daniel Manzano
arxiv-2101-10236.description: Abstract Symmetries in an open quantum system lead to degenerated Liouvillian that physically implies the existence of multiple steady states. In such cases, obtaining the initial condition independent stead states is highly nontrivial since any linear combination of the true asymptotic states, which may not necessarily be a density matrix, is also a valid asymptote for the Liouvillian.

Systems consisting of a single ordinary differential equation coupled with one reaction-diffusion equation in a bounded domain and with the Neumann boundary conditions are studied in the case of particular nonlinearities from the Brusselator model, the Gray-Scott model, the Oregonator model and a certain predator-prey model.

arxiv-2209-05844.title: Quasi-optimal h ​ p hp -finite element refinements towards singularities via deep neural network prediction
arxiv-2209-05844.creator: Tomasz Służalec (1) , Rafał Grzeszczuk (2) , Sergio Rojas (3) , Witold Dzwinel (2) , Maciej Paszyński (2)
arxiv-2209-05844.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Tomasz Służalec (1) , Rafał Grzeszczuk (2) , Sergio Rojas (3) , Witold Dzwinel (2) , Maciej Paszyński (2). We show how to construct the deep neural network (DNN) expert to predict quasi-optimal h ​ p hp -refinements for a given computational problem. The main idea is to train the DNN expert during executing the self-adaptive h ​ p hp -finite element method ( h ​ p hp -FEM) algorithm and use it later to predict further h ​ p hp refinements.

arxiv-2212-04986.description: Abstract Recent observations show that planet formation is already underway in young systems, when the protostar is still embedded into the molecular cloud and the accretion disc is massive. In such environments, the role of self gravity (SG) and gravitational instability (GI) is crucial in determining the dynamical evolution of the disc.

arxiv-2503-20866.title: The gravitational index and allowable complex metrics
arxiv-2503-20866.creator: Pietro Benetti Genolini 1 and Sameer Murthy 2
arxiv-2503-20866.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Pietro Benetti Genolini 1 and Sameer Murthy 2. We study the Konstevich–Segal–Witten criterion for allowable complex metrics, in the context of the gravitational path integral corresponding to the supersymmetric index. In various theories of supergravity in asymptotically flat and asymptotically AdS space, the exponential growth of states of the corresponding microscopic index in string theory is known to be captured by complex saddle points of this path integral.

arxiv-2504-12491.title: When Scale is Fixed: Revisiting Pre-training Indicators for LLM Fine-tuning Performance
arxiv-2504-12491.creator: Hansi Zeng, Kai Hui, Honglei Zhuang, Zhen Qin, Zhenrui Yue, Hamed Zamani, Dana Alon
arxiv-2504-12491.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hansi Zeng, Kai Hui, Honglei Zhuang, Zhen Qin, Zhenrui Yue, Hamed Zamani, Dana Alon. While pre-trained available metrics, such as perplexity, correlates well with model performance at scaling-laws studies, their predictive capacities at a fixed model size remains unclear, hindering effective model selection and development. To address this gap, we formulate the task of selecting pretraining checkpoints to maximize downstream fine-tuning performance as a pairwise classification problem: predicting which of two LLMs, differing in their pre-training, will perform better after supervised fine-tuning (SFT).

pmc-13056783.creator: Agnia Vibriani, Xinyue Chen, Susumu Kajiwara, Kanami Orihara
pmc-13056783.description: AbstractThe increased reliance on digital devices in our daily lives has exposed humans to intense levels of high-energy blue light. pmc-13124639.description: ObjectivesUndocumented immigrants are a highly vulnerable population, frequently exposed to violence and trauma in their country of origin, along the migration journey, and in the host country.
